tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrol dkar tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa'i gsal byed dam zur 'debs bzhugs so// zlum gtor chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod rdor dril/ mchod pa byin rlabs sgrub thabs brgya rgyam bzhin sngags phreng gsal 'debs kyi tshe/ de'i mtha' bskor du/ da sngags don sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par mdzod na pa ti a yuḥpuṇ+ya dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes dang / bzlas bya'i sngags la'ang spel tshig 'di bzhin/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur gyi rjes su/ dmigs rten yod na dang / med na tha mal gyi snang ba a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma dkar po zhes pa nas/ steng du bar/ tāṃ yig dkar po zhes pa nas gyur pa las bar/ rje btsun ma nas/ dbur rgyan par bdag bskyed bzhin gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs brgya rgyam bzhin 'bul tshul bstod pa 'dod gsol bcas dkar chag bzhin/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag sogs so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ sgrol dkar tshe khrid kyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa'i gsal byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
